title: Database and Persistence Technical Reference
readerIntent: Audit persistence ownership, provider capabilities, configuration, and verification.
owner: Nodics database contracts and selected provider
summary: Technical changes must preserve schema authority, generated model behavior, tenant resolution, access policy, lifecycle, and provider abstraction.

sections.heading: Contract checklist
items: Provider identity and truthful capability declaration.
Layered connection aliases, handlers, pool, timeout, retry, TLS, and secret references.
Tenant/module database resolution and model isolation.
Schema, index, CRUD, query, middleware, relationship, and transaction mappings.
Normalized errors, diagnostics, readiness, reconnect, and shutdown.
Import, export, cache, search, event, audit, and runtime-governance interactions.

sections.heading: Verification matrix
items: Positive CRUD/query and transactions where supported.
Negative configuration, authentication, authorization, validation, conflict, and provider failures.
Boundary sizes, pagination, batching, timeouts, pool limits, and tenant counts.
Backup, restore, failover, migration, performance, security, and regression.
